what: Replica of autoproof's adopted semantics lockfile for Blackwell (sm_120) block-scaled FP4: the model verity.ml.tc.models.BLACKWELL_SM120_NVF4 is a port of the gdfs_model it describes.

lock.status: ADOPTED at oracle-v3 (human review 2026-07-11) from the M1 worker's silicon probes on the pinned kernel (proposal: spec/SEMANTICS.lock.v1-proposed.json, branch M1-claude). Supersedes every PENDING-PROBE field of v0. The v0 NATIVE hypothesis (single 26-bit window) was REFUTED by PROBE-3: 142,270 / 1,574,998 dot statements mismatch. The model below matches silicon 1,574,998 / 1,574,998.
lock.k_tile_order: monotone ascending K (as pinned in the probe kernel; PROBE-1: bit-identical across 3000 runs x 5 schedule variants)
lock.split_k_policy: disallowed — atomics forbidden (C4); PROBE-5: cuBLASLt's fastest NVFP4 algo is already splitK=1/no-reduction, tax ~0%
lock.epilogue: identity (FP32 out, no activation, no output quantization)
lock.per_tensor_scale: not applied in the probe statement (unchanged from v0; pin before serving GEMMs)

gdfs_model.structure: five-way align-add per firing: the 4 exact scaled group terms and the carried FP32 accumulator are each truncated toward zero at a common lsb, summed exactly, then normalized RZ to binary32
gdfs_model.addend_lsb: max( E1 - (W1-1), acc != 0 ? ilog2(acc) - (W2-1) : -inf, hot ? -19 : -inf ) with E1 = max exponent over the nonzero addends (acc included)
gdfs_model.alignment_rounding: truncate-toward-zero (per addend, two's-complement floor never observed: PROBE-3 scans + tie_probe)
gdfs_model.normalize_rounding: RZ (both signs, including exact half-ulp ties: tie_probe 120/120, norm_probe 24/24; unscaled path confirmed RZ at the K=116,544 parity boundary: PROBE-2)

hot_group_clip.trigger: any group of the firing with (exists i: a_i * b_i != 0) AND both scale codes in 0x78..0x7E (UE4M3 exponent field 15); gd value irrelevant; misaligned nonzero elements (all products zero) do NOT trigger
hot_group_clip.effect: every addend of that firing (4 terms and the carried accumulator) additionally truncated toward zero at 2^-19: the 2^-20 bit — the deepest reachable NVFP4 term bit (1 quarter x two minimum subnormal scales 2^-9) — is dropped, per addend, before the add
hot_group_clip.scope: per firing; no leakage across the K chain (anchor_probe2 Q3)
hot_group_clip.interpretation: alignment anchor is bounded from scale exponents before group dots are known; the e15+e15 bound overshoots the reachable fixed-point grid by exactly one position at the bottom; equivalently cut = (e_a + e_b) - 50, observable only at e_a + e_b = 30 because no NVFP4 term has bits below 2^-20

gdfs_model.zero_handling: all-addends-zero firing leaves the accumulator bit-identical (incl. -0); exact cancellation normalizes to +0
gdfs_model.status: MEASURED on silicon under this lockfile's kernel; 1,574,998/1,574,998 bitwise (probes/results/probe3_*.json); fp8-e4m3 fields REMOVED (de-scoped, RQ7)

unscaled_fp4_core.exactness: bit-exact vs CANON through K = 116,480 measured (13,082 dots, 0 mismatches); first lossy op past the bound is the RZ normalize (silicon votes RZ on every RNE/RZ-discriminating parity case)
